finalSourceFreeze: After explicit root quiet-window handoff and final QA source recheck; draft is not a frozen execution plan
warmup: Existing reviewed producer unchanged; one full real verified operation per process/case before timing. No thermal/OS-cache steady-state assertion.
sequentialOwnership: One case/process at a time, own50-value latency array/resources/output; record each stage before advancing
latencyRetention: Raw50 elapsedMs values in chronological sample order per result. Median averages25th/26th sorted values; p95 is48th sorted value (nearest-rank).
resourceRetention: Reported aggregate OS sampleCount, sampled absolute direct-child RSS peak, cumulative CPU/marker-window duration and interval-derived CPU peak; individual periodic OS trace not retained by existing host.

units.cpu: one logical core=100%; not divided by8cores; process may exceed100%
units.resourceWindow: One host start/end marker-receipt window per case including inter-iteration setup/verification/reopen/cleanup, not per-sample isolated CPU/RAM

cacheAndMachine: Fresh process per case and fresh store per iteration; code/assets warmed by real warmup; OS caches/background/thermal state uncontrolled. Root to pause other compilers/Device boot.
noPadding: No in-window sleeps/loops added; preserve existing reviewed post-end100ms tail outside windows. Failed/unavailable sampling is not replaced with defaults.
acceptance: Data baseline only after valid runs and independent review; no optimization, numeric budget, GUI/frame/native input/image decode or mobile performance acceptance
retry: No unchanged retry. Any failure preserves its result/ledger, stops the next stage and requires concrete changed evidence under bounded policy; source changes require a successor campaign.
artifactRetention: Keep one canonical raw result plus diagnostics and compact execution/source/cleanup receipts per case. If successful CLI stdout parses equal to canonical result, retain its hash/byte count/equality proof instead of a duplicate full JSON log. Preserve useful failed stdout/stderr and immutable failed stages.
